test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**reportedly**" means according to what some say, a report, or indications. It indicates that the information is based on reports. (रिपोर्ट के अनुसार)
 
• The passage is referring to a statistic about daily deaths due to water-related diseases, which is something that would be obtained from reports and statistics.
 
• The other options: "**ostensibly**," "**distinctly**," and "**assuredly**" do not fit the context as appropriately. "Ostensibly" means apparently or purportedly, but perhaps not actually; "distinctly" means clearly; and "assuredly" means certainly or confidently.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Over 1,600 Indians, most of them children below the age of five, reportedly__ die every day because of water-related diseases.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ostensibly (प्रकट रूप से)**: means apparently or purportedly, but perhaps not actually. It wouldn't be suitable here as it casts doubt on the information.
 
• **Distinctly (स्पष्ट रूप से)**: means clearly. This does not fit well in the context of statistical reporting.
 
• **Assuredly (निश्चित रूप से)**: means certainly or confidently. This would imply a level of certainty that is not applicable to reported figures.

40:Td76,
The correct answer is Option 4.
